## 6. Bootstrap (универсальный)

Bootstrap-CI на разность средних (10 000 ресэмплов) + bootstrap p-value. Используется когда параметрический тест неудобен: ratio-метрики, ненормальные распределения, ситуации с длинными хвостами. Универсальный fallback для `mannwhitney` и `delta_method` в первой версии тула.

import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

metric_col = '{{metric_column}}'
alpha = {{alpha}}

control = df[df['variant'] == 'control'][metric_col].values
treatment = df[df['variant'] == 'treatment'][metric_col].values

observed = treatment.mean() - control.mean()

N_BOOT = 10000
boot_diffs = np.empty(N_BOOT)
for i in range(N_BOOT):
    c = rng.choice(control, size=len(control), replace=True).mean()
    t = rng.choice(treatment, size=len(treatment), replace=True).mean()
    boot_diffs[i] = t - c

ci_lo, ci_hi = np.quantile(boot_diffs, [alpha / 2, 1 - alpha / 2])
# Two-sided bootstrap p-value: proportion of |boot - 0| as extreme as |observed|.
# Center around 0 (H0: no diff) via shift.
centered = boot_diffs - boot_diffs.mean()
p = (np.abs(centered) >= abs(observed)).mean()
rel_lift = observed / control.mean() if control.mean() else float('nan')

print(f'control mean   = {control.mean():.4f}')
print(f'treatment mean = {treatment.mean():.4f}')
print(f'observed diff  = {observed:+.4f}')
print(f'relative lift  = {rel_lift:+.2%}')
print(f'bootstrap p = {p:.4f}')
print(f'CI {1 - alpha:.0%}: [{ci_lo:+.4f}, {ci_hi:+.4f}]')
print('SIGNIFICANT' if p < alpha else 'not significant')
